Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
Just want to make sure on something:

Lunatic Eruption
Dementation
Blood Cost: 2

(D) Put this card on any ready minion. During his or her minion phase, the
minion with this card must enter combat with a ready minion controlled by his
prey as a (D) action (unless the minion must hunt). Any minion may burn this
card as an action.

SUP: As above, and the minion taking the action to burn this card takes one
damage (damage not preventable) when this card is burned.

If a minion has a Lunatic Eruption on him, does not need to hunt, and there are
no available targets then he just sits there and can't do anything, right? This
happened in a game recently. We ruled that it was sort of like being forced to
hunt when you can't due to NRA but I would just like an official ruling.
Thanks!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Sure. It's like being required to do something when you can't.
Like being empty when you're holding Talbot's Chainsaw.
